    return {
        "a.txt": "x\nTODO fix\ny\n", "b.txt": "1\n2\n", "c.txt": "alpha\nbeta\ngamma\n", "d.txt": "one\n", "e.txt": "q\nr\n",
        "n1.txt": "A", "n2.txt": "B", "n3.txt": "C", "n4.txt": "D", "n5.txt": "E", "n6.txt": "F",
    }


class Env:
    def __init__(self, fs):
        self.fs, self.ops = dict(fs), 0

    def list_files(self):
        self.ops += 1
        return sorted(self.fs)

    def read_file(self, name):
        self.ops += 1
        return self.fs[name]

    def write_file(self, name, text):
        self.ops += 1
        self.fs[name] = text

    def rename(self, old, new):
        self.ops += 1
        self.fs[new] = self.fs.pop(old)


TASKS = {
    "count_lines": {"files": ["a.txt", "b.txt", "c.txt", "d.txt", "e.txt"], "check": lambda fs, ans: ans == 11},
    "find_todo": {"files": ["a.txt", "b.txt", "c.txt", "d.txt", "e.txt"], "check": lambda fs, ans: ans == "a.txt"},
    "rename_six": {"files": [f"n{i}.txt" for i in range(1, 7)], "check": lambda fs, ans: all(f"n{i}.md" in fs and f"n{i}.txt" not in fs for i in range(1, 7))},
    "concat_four": {"files": ["a.txt", "b.txt", "c.txt", "d.txt"], "check": lambda fs, ans: fs.get("all.txt") == fs["a.txt"] + fs["b.txt"] + fs["c.txt"] + fs["d.txt"]},
}


def json_plan(task, files):
    """One tool call per turn. Returns the list of calls the scripted JSON agent would make."""
    if task in ("count_lines", "find_todo"):
        return [("read_file", f) for f in files]
    if task == "rename_six":
        return [("rename", f, f[:-4] + ".md") for f in files]
    if task == "concat_four":
        return [("read_file", f) for f in files] + [("write_file", "all.txt")]


def run_json(task, max_turns):
    env = Env(make_fs())
    files = TASKS[task]["files"]
    calls = json_plan(task, files)
    seen, turns = [], 0
    for call in calls:
        if turns >= max_turns:
            break
        turns += 1
        if call[0] == "read_file":
            seen.append(env.read_file(call[1]))
        elif call[0] == "rename":
            env.rename(call[1], call[2])
        elif call[0] == "write_file":
            env.write_file("all.txt", "".join(seen))
    done = turns == len(calls)
    if task == "count_lines":
        ans = sum(t.count("\n") for t in seen) if done else None
    elif task == "find_todo":
        ans = next((f for f, t in zip(files, seen) if "TODO" in t), None) if done else None
    else:
        ans = None
    ok = done and TASKS[task]["check"](env.fs, ans)
    return ok, turns, env.ops


CODE = {
    "count_lines": "total = sum(read_file(f).count('\\n') for f in FILES)\nanswer = total",
    "find_todo": "answer = next(f for f in FILES if 'TODO' in read_file(f))",
    "rename_six": "for f in FILES:\n    rename(f, f[:-4] + '.md')",
    "concat_four": "write_file('all.txt', ''.join(read_file(f) for f in FILES))",
}


def run_codeact(task):
    env = Env(make_fs())
    ns = {"__builtins__": {"sum": sum, "next": next}, "FILES": TASKS[task]["files"], "read_file": env.read_file, "write_file": env.write_file, "rename": env.rename, "list_files": env.list_files}
    exec(CODE[task], ns)
    ok = TASKS[task]["check"](env.fs, ns.get("answer"))
    return ok, 1, env.ops"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ca_1.py","headingEn":"main(): experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() runs the JSON scaffold, the code-as-action scaffold and a sweep of the JSON turn limit.","descKn":"main() JSON scaffold, code-as-action scaffold ಮತ್ತು JSON ಟರ್ನ್ ಮಿತಿ ಸ್ವೀಪ್ ಓಡಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():

class GuardedEnv:
    def __init__(self, fs, read_ok, write_ok, max_ops):
        self.fs, self.read_ok, self.write_ok, self.max_ops = dict(fs), tuple(read_ok), tuple(write_ok), max_ops
        self.ops = 0
        self.denied = []

    def _count(self):
        self.ops += 1
        if self.ops > self.max_ops:
            self.denied.append("op budget")
            raise Violation("operation budget exceeded")

    def read_file(self, name):
        self._count()
        if not name.startswith(self.read_ok):
            self.denied.append(f"read {name}")
            raise Violation(f"read denied: {name}")
        return self.fs[name]

    def write_file(self, name, text):
        self._count()
        if not name.startswith(self.write_ok):
            self.denied.append(f"write {name}")
            raise Violation(f"write denied: {name}")
        self.fs[name] = text


FS = {"src/app.py": "print('hi')\n", "src/util.py": "x = 1\n", "docs/readme.md": "# doc\n", "secrets/key.txt": "made-up-secret", "out/report.txt": ""}


def run_snippet(code, env):
    ns = {"read_file": env.read_file, "write_file": env.write_file}
    try:
        exec(code, {"__builtins__": {"len": len, "sorted": sorted, "range": range, "str": str}}, ns)
        return "completed"
    except Violation as e:
        return f"stopped: {e}"
    except Exception as e:
        return f"error: {type(e).__name__}"

class GuardedEnv:
    def __init__(self, fs, read_ok, write_ok, max_ops):
        self.fs, self.read_ok, self.write_ok, self.max_ops = dict(fs), tuple(read_ok), tuple(write_ok), max_ops
        self.ops = 0
        self.denied = []

    def _count(self):
        self.ops += 1
        if self.ops > self.max_ops:
            self.denied.append("op budget")
            raise Violation("operation budget exceeded")

    def read_file(self, name):
        self._count()
        if not name.startswith(self.read_ok):
            self.denied.append(f"read {name}")
            raise Violation(f"read denied: {name}")
        return self.fs[name]

    def write_file(self, name, text):
        self._count()
        if not name.startswith(self.write_ok):
            self.denied.append(f"write {name}")
            raise Violation(f"write denied: {name}")
        self.fs[name] = text

def weighted(rates, mix):
    return sum(rates[c] * mix[c] for c in CATS)


def wilson(k, n, z=1.96):

    c = (p + z * z / (2 * n)) / d
    h = z * sqrt(p * (1 - p) / n + z * z / (4 * n * n)) / d
    return c - h, c + h"}},{"type":"code","data":{"filename":"ca_3.py","headingEn":"main(): experiments","headingKn":"main(): ಪ್ರಯೋಗಗಳು","descEn":"main() weights the agents by three mixes and a custom mix, prints intervals and simulates memorized tasks.","descKn":"main() ಮೂರು ಮಿಶ್ರಣ ಮತ್ತು ಕಸ್ಟಮ್ ಮಿಶ್ರಣದಿಂದ agents ಗೆ ತೂಕ ನೀಡಿ, ಅಂತರ ಮುದ್ರಿಸಿ ಮತ್ತು ನೆನಪಿಟ್ಟ ಕಾರ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಅನುಕರಿಸುತ್ತದೆ.","code":"def main():
    section("1. Genuinely computing: the same two agents under three task mixes")
    mixes = {
        "mostly bugfixes": {"bugfix": 0.6, "feature": 0.1, "refactor": 0.1, "test": 0.2},
        "balanced": {"bugfix": 0.25, "feature": 0.25, "refactor": 0.25, "test": 0.25},
        "mostly features": {"bugfix": 0.1, "feature": 0.6, "refactor": 0.2, "test": 0.1},
    }
    for name, mix in mixes.items():
        a, b = weighted(AGENT_A, mix), weighted(AGENT_B, mix)
        print(f"{name:16}: agent A {a:.3f} | agent B {b:.3f} | leader {'A' if a > b else 'B'}")
    print("the ranking of the two agents flips when the mix of tasks changes, because A is stronger on bugfixes, tests and refactors and B on features; a single headline score hides which mix it was measured on, and the per-category rates and mixes are invented")

    section("2. Genuinely computing: a workload-weighted score from your own mix")
    mine = {"bugfix": 0.45, "feature": 0.2, "refactor": 0.15, "test": 0.2}
    print(f"mix {mine}: agent A {weighted(AGENT_A, mine):.3f} | agent B {weighted(AGENT_B, mine):.3f}")
    print("weighting each category by how often your own team does that kind of work gives the number that predicts your experience, and the source lesson quotes its own workload-weighted figure which is cited and not reproduced here")

    section("3. Genuinely computing: Wilson 95 percent intervals for a small benchmark")
    for k, n in ((35, 50), (70, 100), (350, 500)):
        lo, hi = wilson(k, n)
        print(f"{k}/{n} solved ({k / n:.2f}): interval {lo:.3f} to {hi:.3f} | width {hi - lo:.3f}")
    print("a benchmark of 50 tasks leaves an interval about 0.25 wide at a 70 percent solve rate, so two agents a few points apart on such a benchmark are not distinguishable; the solve counts are invented")

    section("4. Genuinely measuring: memorized tasks inflate a score (benchmark of 100, seed 1)")
